description: A line comment after an object element separates it from the next element
notes: A line comment is equivalent to a newline, and the prose says newlines between the braces are ignored as whitespace, with priority over the grammar's Newline separator, which leaves no separator here. hashicorp/hcl turns the newline that ends the comment into a newline token and accepts it as a separator (peeker.nextToken in hclsyntax/peeker.go, parseObjectCons in hclsyntax/parser.go).
